model: Real EW-aligned doublet Higgs direction plus CP-even S radial mode; canonically normalized scalar and mass eigenfields, fixed coefficients and X, no independent h G G. Dimensionless normalized Yukawa responses of the archived UV benchmark carried to the Higgs scale; leading physical masses per round 1373. Charged scalar effects on decay, total width and all other decay channels absorbed in common positive normalization. Short-distance from the on-shell gluon amplitude to the fiducial production is matched at leading order. ggF templates, bbH kinematics and soft electroweak thresholds require independent control.
